categoryDesc.general: The classics every interviewer asks, from "Tell me about yourself" to your five-year plan.

categoryDesc.frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, React Native, CSS, state and performance.
categoryDesc.databases: SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, indexes, transactions and schema design.
categoryDesc.devops: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git, cloud, monitoring and security.
categoryDesc.ai-data: Machine learning, LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and data pipelines.
categoryDesc.job-specific: Scenario questions for project, product, business, support, finance, marketing and HR roles.
categoryDesc.hr-salary: Salary, negotiation, notice period, gaps, remote work and questions to ask.

mock.intro: Choose a job, a level and a duration. Questions come one by one; you answer in writing, then rate yourself.
mock.timerHint: Shows a suggested time per answer. It never cuts you off.
mock.limitReached: You have used today's free mock interview. Come back tomorrow or upgrade to Premium for unlimited sessions.
mock.noQuestions: No questions match this selection. Try another level or job.
mock.historyEmpty: Your mock interviews will appear here.
mock.answerHint: Answer as you would speak. Short notes are fine.
mock.ratingIntro: Rate each answer honestly from 1 to 5. Compare with the model answer if you like. This is your own assessment: there is no automatic grading.

advice.structure: Structure your answers: use STAR for experience questions and present-past-future for introductions.
advice.relevance: Answer the exact question first, then add context. Read what the interviewer wants to know on each question.
advice.examples: Prepare two or three real stories with numbers you can reuse across questions.
advice.clarity: Aim for one to two minutes per answer and remove details that do not support your point.
advice.confidence: Practise out loud and repeat sessions: confidence grows with repetition.

mock.transparency: This score is your own assessment based on the grid above. InterviewReady does not evaluate your answers automatically.

builder.intro: Build strong answers step by step, save drafts and compare them with example answers.
builder.noAnswersHint: Start a new answer or open a question and tap "Build my answer".
builder.empty: Your answer will appear here as you write.

structureHint.star: Situation, Task, Action, Result: tell a real story and spend most of it on your actions.
structureHint.motivation: Why you, why this role: motivation, relevant experience, skills and what you will bring.
structureHint.present-past-future: Who you are today, how you got here and why this job is your next step.
structureHint.technical: Define the concept, explain how it works, give an example and discuss trade-offs.
structureHint.negotiation: Give a researched range, justify it, show flexibility and close positively.

situation.label: Situation
situation.hint: Where and when? Give the context in one or two sentences.

task.label: Task
task.hint: What was your responsibility or goal?

action.label: Action
action.hint: What did YOU do, step by step? This is the most important part.

result.label: Result
result.hint: What changed? Use numbers if you can, and what you learned.

motivation.label: Motivation
motivation.hint: What attracts you to this role or company, concretely?

experience.label: Relevant experience
experience.hint: Which past experience prepares you for it?

skills.label: Skills
skills.hint: Which two or three skills will you use in this job?

contribution.label: Expected contribution
contribution.hint: What will you bring in the first months?

present.label: Present
present.hint: Your current role or situation and a key strength.

past.label: Past
past.hint: The experience that led you here, with one achievement.

future.label: Future
future.hint: Why this job is the logical next step for you.

definition.label: Definition
definition.hint: Define the concept in one or two simple sentences.

how.label: How it works
how.hint: Explain the mechanism or the main steps.

example.label: Example
example.hint: A concrete example, ideally from your own work.

tradeoffs.label: Trade-offs
tradeoffs.hint: Limits, alternatives or when you would not use it.

range.label: Range
range.hint: Your researched range for this role and location.

justification.label: Justification
justification.hint: Why: market data, experience, scope of the role.

flexibility.label: Flexibility
flexibility.hint: What else matters: benefits, remote work, training, review date.

close.label: Close
close.hint: A positive sentence that keeps the conversation open.

check.length: Between 30 seconds and 2.5 minutes when spoken
check.result-measurable: The result includes a number or measurable outcome
check.first-person: The action describes what you did ("I")

builder.checksNote: Simple writing checks, not an evaluation of your answer.

data.title: Your data
data.intro: Everything you write in InterviewReady (answers, notes, progress) is stored only on this phone. No account, no cloud copy. Keep a backup if you change phones.
data.backupDesc: Creates a file with your progress, favorites, notes and answers. Save it somewhere safe; you choose where it goes.
data.exportAnswersDesc: A readable document with your Answer Builder answers and mock interview answers, to review or print before an interview.
data.exported: File ready. Choose where to save or share it.
data.importDesc: Replaces the data on this phone with the content of a backup file.
data.importConfirmBody: Your current data on this phone will be replaced. This cannot be undone.
data.importInvalid: This file is not a valid InterviewReady backup.
data.importNewer: This backup comes from a newer version of the app. Update InterviewReady, then try again.
data.deleteDesc: Erases your progress, favorites, notes, answers, mock interviews and plans from this phone. Your Google Play purchases are not affected.
data.deleteConfirmBody: Everything will be erased from this phone. This cannot be undone. Make a backup first if you want to keep it.
